messages:
incident-bot: Pager: elevated inference tail-latency in eu-west. Detected sustained GPU eviction rate + autoscaler thrash. Impact: some Dedicated pools reporting >500ms p95 and ~6% request failures. Paging oncall. https://ops.redwood.internal/alerts/2201234567

maria (oncall): I’m on it. jumping into bridge now. bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridge/2201234567

simon (infra): thanks. initial guess: spot node churn + aggressive downscale window. autoscaler logs show repeated scale-downs every ~3m.

kevin (sre): seeing queue backlog on inference-queue-eu-west-1. spike at 11:03 UTC correlates with preemptions. Logs: `preempted: 14 nodes in 7m`

anya (support): any visible customer tickets? CS reporting latency in EU customers. I’ll start a rapid impact summary for customer-facing comms.

maria (oncall): mitigation checklist — enabling eviction-mitigation playbook. Steps: 1) pause autoscaler downscales; 2) force-roll tenants to fallback cpu instances for low-priority routes; 3) temp increase dedicated pool capacity; 4) open postmortem + assign owners. Doing step 1 now.

runbook-bot: runbook "eviction-mitigation" invoked by maria (oncall). Link: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/eviction-mitigation

kevin (sre): command to pause downscales (already tested):
```
kubectl -n infra patch hpa/global-autoscaler --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/behavior/scaleDown/stabilizationWindowSeconds","value":1800}]'
```
applied. scaling down stabilized to 30m.

simon (infra): ramping dedicated-gpu-pool-eu-west by +8 gpus (modal type: a100-80). Provision request sent to infra-provisioning: PR-4382. ETA ~6m.

maria (oncall): Kevin, can you route lower-priority traffic to cpu-fallback? Use route policy `fallback:cpu` for tenants tier=free or tier=dev.

kevin (sre): done. sample route change:
```
PATCH /v1/routes/eu-west
body: {"routing":{"policy":"fallback:cpu","match":[{"meta.tier":"dev"}]}}
```
Applying now. Expect queue drops to reduce in ~1-2min.

anya (support): I posted an internal note to customers impacted and flagged high-touch accounts. Draft message ready, awaiting product signoff.

priya (product): ACK. Edit the comms to call out degraded p95 and temporary routing to CPU. No SLA breach yet, monitoring closely.

maria (oncall): Observability: creating a deck with token-level cost/latency slices and per-route impact. Adding to the incident doc. https://incidents.redwood/2201234567

simon (infra): infra-provisioning confirmed partial capacity allocation. New nodes are booting. Node bootstrap logs look clean.

kevin (sre): backlog reduced ~55% after route switch + pause downscales. p95 dropped from 520ms -> 260ms. Failures down to ~1.2%. Still above target though.

maria (oncall): plan for next hour: 1) let new GPUs come up; 2) keep downscale pause; 3) run KV cache warmup for hot routes; 4) create remediation tickets for autoscaler tuning and spot fallback. Owners: simon, kevin, priya.

simon (infra): creating follow-up tickets now:
- INFRA-8721 autoscaler: increase cooldown & prevent oscillation on spot clusters
- INFRA-8722 node-labeling: mark critical pools non-preemptible
- INFRA-8723 capacity-playbook: auto-request extra capacity when eviction_rate > 5%

kevin (sre): added remediation item: SRE-551 cpu-fallback-latency-tuning — measure perf delta and add heuristics to avoid routing noisy models.

anya (support): customer impact summary (short): ~14 accounts saw p95 spikes, 3 reported timeouts. All high-touch accounts contacted; two requested follow-up call. I’ll log FRs in support workspace.

maria (oncall): scheduling post-incident review: propose tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Priya, Simon, Kevin, Anya — pls confirm availability. We need owners for action items and timelines.

priya (product): I can do 09:30 UTC. will prepare customer-impact slides and recovery timeline.

simon (infra): yep. calendar invite incoming.

kevin (sre): ok. I’ll own SRE-551 and help with repro & telemetry.

maria (oncall): quick note: we toggled canary routing for model-x for a short window as a knee-jerk — add rollback check to postmortem.

runbook-bot: created incident ticket INC-2201234567. Postmortem placeholder created.

maria (oncall): current status: mitigated -> degraded stable. continuing monitoring for 2h. leaving bridge in 30m. Handing to simon for long-running infra remediation.

simon (infra): taking lead for remediation. will post updates in thread INFRA-8721.

anya (support): will follow up with customers and share final comms after postmortem.

maria (oncall): thanks everyone. short retro notes: better preempt metrics, autoscaler thresholds too aggressive, and clearer runbook step to throttle non-prod traffic earlier. Action items assigned in tickets above. :thumbsup:
